title: Worksheet 6: Privacy Settings and Parental Controls
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Roblox includes privacy settings and parental controls that allow a parent or guardian to adjust what a player can see and do on the platform. These settings can control things like who is allowed to chat with a player, whether voice chat is turned on, what kinds of games appear as recommended, and how much real money can be spent inside the app. Roblox also offers an account setting called "Account Restrictions," which limits chat and content even further for younger players, blocking most chat features and only allowing access to games designed for a younger audience. Because every family may have different rules about what feels appropriate, parents and guardians are encouraged to review these settings together with their child and adjust them based on the child's age and maturity. Regularly checking privacy settings is helpful because Roblox occasionally updates its features, which can sometimes change default settings without a player realizing it.
